title: BRD4 Phosphorylation Regulates the Structure of Chromatin Nanodomains.
authors: Seitz, Clayton; Fu, Donghong; Liu, Mengyuan; Ma, Hailan; Liu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与活细胞成像研究BRD4磷酸化对染色质纳米结构域的影响，涉及蛋白-染色质互作与相分离，但核心非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The interplay between chromatin structure and phase-separating proteins is an emerging topic in cell biology with implications for understanding disease states. Here, we investigate the functional relationship between bromodomain protein 4 (BRD4) and chromatin architecture. By combining molecular dynamics simulations with live-cell imaging, we demonstrate that BRD4, when mutated at specific N-terminus sites, significantly impacts the organization and dynamics of chromatin nanodomains, known as nucleosome clutches. Our findings reveal that a constitutively phosphorylated mutant of BRD4 condenses nucleosome clutches, while treatment with (+)-JQ1 increases the diffusion dynamics of single nucleosomes and decondenses nucleosome clutches. Simultaneously, we demonstrate that BRD4 mutations can alter localization of BRD4 to chromatin as well as modify single nucleosome dynamics. These results suggest that both chromatin binding and phase separation of BRD4 could co-regulate the nanoscale chromatin architecture and the chromatin microenvironment. Our observations shed light on the nuanced regulation of chromatin structure by BRD4, offering insights into its role in maintaining the nuclear architecture and transcriptional activity.
abstract_zh: 染色质结构与相分离蛋白之间的相互作用是细胞生物学中的一个新兴课题，对理解疾病状态具有重要意义。在此，我们研究了溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）与染色质结构之间的功能关系。通过结合分子动力学模拟与活细胞成像，我们证明BRD4在特定N端位点发生突变时，显著影响被称为核小体簇（nucleosome clutches）的染色质纳米域的组织和动态。我们的发现揭示，BRD4的组成性磷酸化突变体使核小体簇凝聚，而(+)-JQ1处理则增加单个核小体的扩散动态并使核小体簇解凝聚。同时，我们证明BRD4突变可改变BRD4在染色质上的定位，并修饰单个核小体的动态。这些结果表明，BRD4的染色质结合和相分离可能共同调控纳米尺度染色质结构及染色质微环境。我们的观察阐明了BRD4对染色质结构的精细调控，为其在维持核结构和转录活性中的作用提供了见解。
